title: “Granado offers the world an authentic Brazil,” says Sissi Freeman
summary: Brazilian beauty brand Granado is continuing its international expansion. Now present in the UK, France, Spain, Portugal and the US, the brand is bringing a distinctive vision of Brazilian perfumery to international markets. We spoke with Sissi Freeman, Marketing and Sales Director, during the Paris presentation in June of Yes, Nós Temos Banana! Premium Beauty News - Where does the Granado brand stand today? Sissi Freeman - With projected revenue of approximately BRL 1.9 billion in 2025,...
